title: Nordrassil
wikitext:
[[Image:Nordrassil.jpg|thumb|Nordrassil and Archimonde's remains]]'''Nordrassil''' is the original [[World Tree]] of the [[Night Elf|night elves]], meaning "crown of the heavens" in their language.

The tree was grown from an acorn of the Mother Tree [[G'Hanir]] by the [[Dragon Aspects|great dragon]] [[Alexstrasza]] in the waters of the newly reborn [[Well of Eternity]] on [[Mount Hyjal]].  The tree was also blessed by [[Nozdormu]] and [[Ysera]], and the night elves' bond to it was the source of their immortality.

During the [[Battle of Mount Hyjal]], [[Malfurion Stormrage]] used the primal fury of Nordrassil and hundreds of nature spirits to defeat [[Archimonde]], sacrificing the night elves' immortality and causing a devastating shockwave.  While the tree appeared to be healing well when last seen, the area is currently not accessible and its current status is unknown.
